audit: STAGE-B provenance audit (ARM P pre-flight, AUDIT ONLY, no training run)
arm_p_definition: ARM P = full SceneFlow pretrain -> existing P2A fine-tune. Not Phase 3. Not a new arm.
downstream_path: STOPPED: upstream-checkpoint path STOPPED (absent checkpoint + architecture mismatch). Viable path is pretraining P2A's OWN architecture (ARM P), which makes strict loading satisfiable by construction (still MUST be verified, never assumed).

file_listing.note: Recursive file listing returned only .py/.md/.png/.yaml/.txt/.gitignore; zero .tar/.pth/checkpoint files. No checkpoint file exists in the extraction.

q1_pretrain_dataset.answer: Full SceneFlow corpus via dataloader/listflowfile.py:16-117: FlyingThings3D TRAIN (frames_cleanpass + frames_disparity, subdirs A/B/C) as train, FlyingThings3D TEST as test, plus Monkaa (monkaa frames + disparity) and Driving (35mm/15mm x backwards/forwards x fast/slow). SceneFlowLoader.py:30-79 reads PFM GT raw in pixels.

q2_what_checkpoint_is_actually_supplied.answer: NONE. No checkpoint file is supplied in the extraction (verified by listing). The string checkpoints/checkpoint_sceneflow.tar appears only as (a) the save path written every epoch by sceneflow-pretrain.py:70,155-160 and (b) the --loadmodel/resume default in finetune-kitti15.py:32,76-81. An undistributed path, not an artifact.

q3_architecture_that_produced_it.answer: The 4-level upstream StereoNet in models/stereonet.py:7-57: FOUR stride-2 5x5 convs (stride 16), 6 ResBlocks + output conv, MetricBlock 3D aggregation (Conv3d+BatchNorm3d+LeakyReLU x4, Conv3d 32->1), refinement Conv2d(4->32)+6 dilated ResBlocks+Conv2d(32->1) with BatchNorm2d throughout, final ReLU on (initial+residual). log.txt:4 records 424610 params for this architecture.

q4_cost_volume_construction.answer: utils/cost_volume.py:5-44: CostVolume(D=192, k=4, batch_size, channel=32). Loop over range(D // 2**k) = 192//16 = 12 candidates at feature stride 16 (16 px full-res spacing, 176 px max grid). Subtract (or concat->64ch) of shifted-left vs right candidate; stack to [B, D, C, H, W]. forward_stage2 calls it with k=4 (models/stereonet.py:83).

q5_tensor_conventions.answer: SceneFlowLoader returns (left_img, right_img, dataL): images ToTensor+ImageNet-Normalize to (3,256,512); disparity dataL is the RAW PFM float32 array cropped to 256x512, shape (H,W) in PIXELS (no channel dim, no /256). Pretrain train(): Variable(FloatTensor) batches, output squeezed to (B,H,W) before masked smooth-L1 (sceneflow-pretrain.py:86-108).

q6_normalization.answer: Images: ImageNet mean [0.485,0.456,0.406] std [0.229,0.224,0.225] via ToTensor+Normalize (dataloader/preprocess.py:5-6,21-29); executed path calls get_transform(augment=False) (SceneFlowLoader.py:63,72; KITTILoader.py:72,89), so NO colour jitter runs despite inception_color_preproccess existing at preprocess.py:61-73. P2A uses the identical constants x255 on 0-255 RGB (NORM_MEAN 123.675/116.28/103.53, NORM_STD 58.395/57.12/57.375, src/datasets/kitti2015.py:38-39) - same normalization, different application point.

q7_disparity_representation.answer: PFM pixels used RAW (no /256; /256 is KITTI-PNG-only, cf KITTILoader.py:69,87). Pretrain loss mask: disp < maxdisp, maxdisp default 160 (sceneflow-pretrain.py:20-21,96-103). Test EPE slices output[:,4:,:] (sceneflow-pretrain.py:124). Upstream soft-argmin emits candidate indices 0..11 (models/stereonet.py:179-194), refinement supplies scale, forward ReLUs the sum (models/stereonet.py:101-116). KITTI finetune instead masks disp > 0 with no maxdisp cap.

q8_which_script_produced_it.answer: pretrain-sceneflow/sceneflow-pretrain.py (epochs default 20, batch 16, RMSprop lr 1e-3 wd 0.0001, ExponentialLR gamma 0.9, seed default 1) writes checkpoints/checkpoint_sceneflow.tar every epoch (overwrite, keeps optimizer+epoch+loss). No produced checkpoint is present, so no produced artifact can be named; the script is the only provenance of the filename.

q9_loadable_into_p2a.answer: NO. Strict load is unsatisfiable: 424610 != 397954 params; upstream has BatchNorm2d/3d layers (dozens of weight/bias/running-mean/var keys) P2A lacks entirely; downsample depth 4 vs 3; D 12 vs 24 (aggregation/refinement-adjacent shapes differ); ResBlock/MetricBlock definitions differ (bias=False+BN vs biased bias-carrying convs, LeakyReLU placement); upstream checkpoints saved under DataParallel 'module.' prefix (cf export.py:7-15 stripping it with strict=False). P2A must NOT be modified to accept it; no such change is proposed.

q10_readme_ablation_associated.answer: NO. README.md:19-48 reports SceneFlow epoch-22 loss 3.956 / test EPE 3.496 and KITTI 300/2000-epoch 3-px variants (80.893/83.527/90.054/93.680), but no checkpoint is distributed, so no reported number is tied to any loadable artifact. log.txt contradicts/complements rather than confirms: it shows a run restarted from '-- no checkpoint --' reaching only epoch ~9 with epoch loss ~4.7-12.5, never epoch 22. Association is unestablishable.
